mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals an accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment rate above 5.5% (UNRATE > 5.5%) signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5.5%) signals severe economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to policy ineffectiveness.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS < 0.5% AND UNRATE > 5.5%), or the Rank IC for the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a housing market expansion (HOUST > 1100 thousand units), rising residential construction activity boosts consumer confidence and economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 1100, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of total employment (PAYEMS > 140,000 thousand) signals robust labor market conditions that sustain consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 140000, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 95 (INDPRO < 95) signals manufacturing contraction and supply chain disruption, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 95, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high housing starts (HOUST > 1100) and low industrial production (INDPRO < 95) signals sectoral imbalance where housing demand outpaces manufacturing supply, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (HOUST > 1100 AND INDPRO < 95), or the Rank IC for the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a recessionary labor market regime (UNRATE > 5.5%), reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings pressure lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
